answer: Proof of stake serves as a nebula for consensus, requiring agents to bond capital to participate. By creating a terrace of financial tiers, the network forces an attacker to commit significant wealth to acquire voting power. Much like an vast ocean of collateral, this cost ensures that creating fake identities is economically irrational, as each new entity dilutes the attacker’s own existing stake rather than granting them unearned influence over the decentralized ledger’s state transitions.
